title: Segugio
tagline: Deploy copy-trading bots directly from a chat bot using human-readable commands and see portfolio analytics.
how_its_made:
This project is designed for the XMTP ecosystem, we would like to incentivize users to join a decentralized message client by giving them a smooth UI and superpowers.
The XMTP bot is written using Typescript, Brianlang and XMTP MessageKit.
The portfolio analytics are generated through 1Inch apis, which allow us to put a lot of onchain bots stats together.
